sources.title: Fans fear for Simpsons Hit & Run remake after unannounced game from devs behind the OG is canceled
sources.text: First thing tomorrow morning I'm gonna punch Lenny in the back of the head New Radical Games has had its unannounced project canceled according to a developer, with the studio speculated to have been working on a The Simpsons: Hit & Run remake. Earlier this year, Simpsons creator Matt Groening casually dropped the news that something to do with The Simpsons: Hit & Run was happening, saying at a D23 panel that "the original game is coming back in some form." This, mixed with New Radical's now-deleted LinkedIn hiring post that mentioned "our stylized game" which would naturally fit with The Simpsons, had folks speculating that the studio – partially comprised of devs from OG Hit & Run studio, Radical Entertainment – might be working on a remake. However, whatever the studio was working on has now unfortunately been scrapped. Darren Evenson – senior game designer at New Radical Games – posts on LinkedIn saying the devs' latest project "was part of a whole gaggle of cancellations." While The Simpsons link is still unconfirmed, Evenson writes "if you don't make the money, then you don't get the power" which is a reference to Scarface – which Radical also worked on a game for. However, this line was famously parodied in The Simpsons when Homer has his giant pile of sugar in the backyard. I could be reading entirely too much into it, but that could be a hint that this was sadly a Hit & Run remaster that was canned. Needless to say, fans aren't happy. "I'm never going to emotionally recover from this," one says on Twitter in response. "Yeah bro is paraphrasing a quote from Homer it's over boys," speculates another . There's no wonder the news is having such an impact, even without confirmation that a remake was definitely canceled. Sure, GTA 6 is the highest-rated game of all time and people were waiting 13 years for it to come out, but after 23 years, The Simpsons Hit & Run was the real open-world car-stealing game that everyone was waiting to see get a follow-up. The iconic licensed title is still one of the most beloved games ever made, and fans have been asking for a sequel for decades, but despite its massive success – and reports emerging that there was a sequel in the works – one never came to fruition. The unrelated The Simpsons Game was the only console game the franchise has had since. sources.title: The Simpsons Hit & Run remake may have been cancelled as developer seemingly hints they were working on it
sources.text: Speculation surrounding a remake has been rife since Matt Groening suggested it was coming The remake of The Simpsons: Hit & Run that was rumoured to be in development may now have been cancelled. There’s been some speculation that a remake was in the works, particularly when its studio Radical Entertainment returned this year as New Radical Games and included Hit & Run artwork on its homepage that was slightly different to that of the original game. This was then followed by apparent confirmation by Simpsons creator Matt Groening , who seemingly let slip during the D23 conference in August that the original game was returning. Now it appears that we may never see a remake after all, with New Radical Games senior game designer Darren Evenson posting on LinkedIn that the studio’s unannounced project had been scrapped and he was now looking for work as a result. “It seems that not even a fantastic project with an absolutely incredible team is immune from the current state of the industry right now, as what we were working on at New Radical Games (although mind-blowingly awesome) was part of a whole gaggle of cancellations,” he wrote. “A gaggle, I say! “Oh, you silly suits with spreadsheets… will you EVER learn? If you don’t make the game, you can’t make the money… and if you don’t make the money, then you don’t get the power… and… well, there’s more to that quote, but I digress. “For the first time in my career, I am Available For Work and looking for a new exciting opportunity where I can make some fun games with some great people! Please reach out, shout out, or perform some interpretive dance if you know of an opportunity that a hip cat like me could groove to.” While Evenson doesn’t explicitly say that he’s referring to The Simpsons Hit & Run, the “will you ever learn” echoes a popular Troy McClure line from the show (“oh, Shakazaramesh, will you ever learn?”). His line about “if you don’t make the money, then you don’t get the power” could refer to the movie Scarface, where Tony Montana says: “In this country, you gotta make the money first. Then when you get the money, you get the power. Then when you get the power, then you get the women.” Radical Entertainment also developed Scarface: The World is Yours, which means Evenson may have been referring to a Scarface game instead. The Simpsons does include a parody of this line too, however, where a sleeping Homer defending a pile of sugar says: “In America, first you get the sugar, then you get the power, then you get the women.” During a Simpsons panel at the D23 conference in August, the panel was asked whether, now that a second Simpsons Movie was on the way, there was the potential for a second Hit & Run game too. âThat would certainly be a treat,â The Simpsons showrunner Matt Selman said. Selman co-wrote the original Hit & Run game, as well as its predecessor The Simpsons: Road Rage. âI donât know if Iâm speaking out of turn, [but] I think the original game is coming back in some form,â Groening then said, to gasps in the audience. âOrâ¦ not,â Selman comedically interjected, seemingly trying to de-escalate Groeningâs apparent confirmation. Groening then quickly changed the subject by telling an anecdote about the making of the games instead.

Fans speculated it may have been working on a remake of the PS2-era classic following comments made by Simpsons creator Matt Groening at D23. A gaggle, I say!” Darren Evenson, a developer who started back at Radical Entertainment in the 2000s and was part of the newest incarnation of the studio, wrote on LinkedIn (via VGC ). Current Simpsons showrunner Matt Selman then interrupted him to add an “or not,” suggesting the game’s return was supposed to stay a secret.Â Hit & RunÂ was never ported to current platforms and would be an obvious candidate for one amid the current wave of retro remasters. A Simpsons: Hit & Run 2Â and a Scarface 2 were some of the canceled projects the original version of Radical Entertainment had worked on before prior to becoming an Activision support studio. sources.title: Rumored The Simpsons: Hit & Run remake may be in trouble after one developer says their "mind-blowingly awesome" project is cancelled
sources.text: A rumored remake of The Simpsons: Hit & Run (the internet's most-wanted video game revival) may be in trouble. Just earlier this year, Radical Entertainment made somewhat of a comeback as New Radical Games - with the original studio's co-founder (Ian Wilkinson) and former developer (Tim Bennison) serving as New Radical's CEO and COO, respectively. The company best known for Prototype and the well-remembered open-world Simpsons game was back, in some sense. Whatever project the studio was cooking hasn't been so lucky, it seems. New Radical Games senior game designer Darren Evenson recently said an upcoming project at the company had been scrapped, and he's now looking for new work, per a LinkedIn post . "It seems that not even a fantastic project with an absolutely incredible team is immune from the current state of the industry right now, as what we were working on at New Radical Games (although mind-blowingly awesome) was part of a whole gaggle of cancellations," Evenson wrote. "A gaggle, I say!" "Oh, you silly suits with spreadsheets... will you EVER learn? If you don't make the game, you can't make the money... and if you don't make the money, then you don't get the power... and... well, there's more to that quote, but I digress." "For the first time in my career, I am Available For Work and looking for a new exciting opportunity where I can make some fun games with some great people," he added. "Please reach out, shout out, or perform some interpretive dance if you know of an opportunity that a hip cat like me could groove to." New Radical Games has never formally revealed its plans, but a couple clues pointed to something Simpsons-shaped. As VGC noted, Evenson's statement echoes a few popular lines from the iconic animated sitcom. "Will you ever learn" is suspiciously close to a particular Troy McClure quote , for one. Then there's seemingly a Scarface riff in the developer's statement - one that was also parodied in The Simpsons, of course: "In America, first you get the sugar, then you get the power, then you get the women." It's worth noting Radical Entertainment did also make Scarface: The World Is Yours , so this one could go either way. But the most eyebrow-raising clue came from original Simpsons co-showrunner and creator Matt Groening . During a Disney D23 panel this summer, Groening and current showrunner Matt Selman were asked about the possibility of a Hit & Run comeback. "I don't know [if] I'm speaking out of turn, I think the original game is coming back in some form," Groening said at the time, before Selman quickly chimed in: "Or not…" "Hit & Run is so interesting. I'm a thousand years old, and when I was in my mid to late 20s, I helped write Hit & Run," Selman said back in March . "I had no idea it would become a cult game, a cult success. Of all the games, the thousands of Simpsons games... that one..."

stories.title: Where to find GTA 6's UFO and alien

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Where to find GTA 6's UFO and alien
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 might feel more grounded compared to its predecessors, but that doesn't mean Leonida isn't full of weird and supernatural ongoings. One such paranormal activity is GTA 6 's aliens—if you know where to look, you'll be able to find a UFO which'll eventually lead you down a strange road of cows, radiation, and the aliens themselves. And if you don't know where to look, here's where I can help you. If you want to find GTA 6's UFO and a weird little alien guy, here's exactly where you need to go and what you need to do. The alien abduction is actually a three-parter mission, and to get started you'll first need to locate the abandoned car. You'll need to look for it at nighttime, and it can spawn in a number of locations. For me, it was a little ways east of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County. For our own Chris Livingston, he discovered the car somewhere north of Capri, also in Kelly County. You know it's the one if the car is pointed toward a forest and the doors are open. Once you've found it, you'll need to follow the path it's parked along. You'll know you're going the right way by the clothes strewn along the path. If it's a bit too dark or you're stuck, you can press L3 + R3 to activate your focus and see the clothes more easily or equip your flashlight. Eventually you'll see the lights of the UFO and a very naked lady amongst it all. Head over until a cutscene plays out. Once that's over, you'll get into a light scuffle with the woman before she instructs you to go get her car. Head back to where you first found the vehicle, where one more cutscene will play out and you'll be done… for now. You'll need to wait for some time to pass. Make sure you're heading home and going to sleep each night, preferably as whichever character you discovered the UFO on. Eventually, you'll trigger a cutscene that'll bring you to a white room. Find the dark oval which signals the way to a corridor and run through it. You'll be met with a terrifying maze of eggs. Get close to them and they'll start glowing blue. Get too close and they'll turn yellow, eventually cracking and causing your character to be yoinked back to the start by tentacles. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. Carefully make your way through the eggs, finding large gaps where you won't cause them to break. Once you've made it to the other side, you'll be met with another room containing the solar system. Take a look at earth—this is actually showing you where you'll need to head for part three of this mission—and continue onwards until you reach a code. To decipher the code, simply look at how many lines are in each of the four symbols above the keypad. For me, the code was 3124. Punch in the code, and head to the next room. Here, you'll need to push the button on the control panel and light it up. The aim is to have four green lights, so keep pushing until all four are the same colour and then pull the lever to the left. Once that's done, you'll be met with three metal doors. The middle one'll do some nasty damage if you step into the room and hang around too long, so avoid it. Instead, head to the room on the left—yes, the one with the cows—and run in to grab the bottle of milk on the table. Run back out and head for the door on the right. Walk to the end until you see a contraption where you're able to insert your milk bottle. Shortly after, you'll wake up back in your bed and ready to tackle the final part of this mission chain. You'll want to head over to the location shown to you in the globe. More specifically, you'll want to head south of Hamlet, at this abandoned building just west of the river. There'll be a gap in the fence you can hop over, or you can shoot the padlock, or alternatively ram into the gate with your car. From here, you can either climb on top of the roof and drop down or find the double doors and kick them down, or use the snap gun. Either way, you'll want to make sure the door is unlocked for later in this mission. Turn around and head down the stairs, towards the keypad at the end of the corridor. The code here is the same as the one you used earlier, so punch it in again and head into the elevator. Walk through the tunnel and you'll once again be met with a control panel and three doors, plus a little audiotape with some fun exposition about alien experimentation. You'll be doing the exact same thing here as you did earlier—get every light to green, push the lever, and head into the left room to retrieve a bottle of milk. The middle room once again doles out gnarly damage, so don't hang too long or avoid it all together. Head over to the door on the right, down the corridor and into the room. Insert the milk bottle into the contraption and after a few seconds, out will pop a little alien guy! It's unconscious, though, so you'll need to pick it up. As soon as you've picked up the alien, the bunker will begin to fill with toxic gas and you'll need to head out ASAP. Go back the way you came—through the tunnel and into the elevator, and then through those double doors you snap gunned/kicked down earlier to get outside. Sadly, your time with this alien fella is brief, as it'll quickly get beamed up into the sky by a UFO. It also doesn't take long for special forces to show up, but don't worry. The UFO will return to laser them all down, allowing you to get out without any further issues. For your troubles, the aliens will give you a permanent buff to your health, stamina, and focus, so helping out these extraterrestrials is more than worth the effort. And, y'know, the trauma. sources.title: GTA 6 All Kitty Litter lab locations: Where to find all drug labs & North Balsero code
sources.text: Find all 20 Kitty Litter lab locations in GTA 6 with our complete guide. Discover every drug lab, the Balsero keypad code and how to unlock Spin On This The Kitty Litter labs in GTA 6 are a series of hidden drug laboratories scattered across Vice City and its surrounding areas. Finding and destroying them is part of Jason’s side activities with Tyrone and Dook, but tracking down every location can be tricky. If you’re struggling to find the laboratories, this guide covers all 20 mapped Kitty Litter lab locations in GTA 6, including directions to their entrances and tips for dealing with the guards protecting them. This guide also gives you the North Balsero Lockup code.Â Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock the Kitty Litter activity, you’ll first need to complete the Chapter 3 story mission Here, Kitty Kitty. After meeting Tyrone and Dook, you’ll be introduced to the drug laboratory operation and tasked with tracking down the locations around Vice City. Look out for purple smoke coming from buildings, Spin On This laundry vans parked outside and purple cat graffiti. These are useful indicators that a Kitty Litter lab is nearby. There are 20 mapped laboratory locations to discover. Here’s where to find them. There are three Kitty Litter Labs outside of the Vice City area of the map, all thrree of which of which are in the are just to the right of the airport. Four more are across the river to Vice City west, with the remaining Kitty Litter Labs spread across the city itself. While you can just use my map above to tick them all off, if you want specific details and zoomed-in map locations, check the list below. Find the flats and head towards the second door on the top floor. The entrance is locked, so climb onto the green dumpster around the right-hand side and enter through the open window. You can also blow the door open with an explosive. Look for the Spin On This laundry van beside the flats. Take the staircase on the right and enter the laboratory through the door at the top. Head through the trailer park until you reach a parked car. Climb through the open window of the nearby white trailer to access the laboratory. Find the two laundry vans in the parking area. Jump over the fence and head left through the gate. The laboratory is behind the shutter beside one of the vans. Find the laundry van outside the flats. Take the staircase in the parking lot and head to the second floor. The laboratory is behind the white door furthest to the right. Look for the laundry van beside the southern entrance to the plaza. Head upstairs and find flat 103, identified by the purple containers outside. Find the laundry van parked outside the garage. The laboratory is behind the large shutter. You can open the shutter with the Slim Jim, or blow it up. Head towards the tattoo parlour’s parking lot and locate the laundry van. The laboratory is behind the parlour, accessible through a brown shutter. Find the laundry van beside the fence in the alley. Enter through the guarded gate and look for the laboratory to the left of the cat picture. Look for the large garage gate beside the laundry van. Enter the keypad code 1999 to access the laboratory. Find the laundry van beside the parking lot entrance. Take the staircase on the right and head upstairs to flat 5. The laboratory is behind the middle grey door. Look for the purple smoke Look for the laundry van parked in the lot. Walk around the right-hand side of the building to find the laboratory behind a brown garage shutter. Head towards Peterson’s Autoshop. Move the laundry van blocking the garage entrance to reveal the laboratory shutter. Enter the trailer park through the double gates on the eastern side. Head towards the last trailer on the right. Be prepared to deal with the hostile occupants. Find the laundry van and continue down the nearby alley. Look for the yellow garage shutters. The laboratory is behind the shutter beside the cat picture. Locate the laundry van outside the houses. Walk around the side of the building and look for the white ground-floor entrance. Enter the building where the laundry van is parked outside. Look for the second door on the left. Enter through the green gate on the north-western side of the trailer park. Turn right, then left after passing the white van. Look for the green house with purple smoke coming from it. Enter the parking lot through the southern entrance and make your way towards the garage shutter. Open it to access the laboratory. Enter the trailer park through the south-eastern entrance and turn left. Look for the trailer with green trim and purple smoke coming from it. The Spin On This laundry van is parked outside. Once you’ve found a laboratory, you’ll need to destroy its drug-making equipment. You can actually complete Kitty Litter Labs incredibly quickly. If you have a grenade, or a sticky bomb, you can launch it into the lab and wait for it to explode. That will destroy the lab, but the only issue is that it will almost certainly also kill the cook that’s in the lab. If they’re not aggresive (as opposed to a gang member), then killing them will impact your Criminal Profile. Destroying Kitty Litter laboratories rewards you with cash and helps progress Tyrone’s side-mission storyline. Destroying 15 laboratories unlocks the next stage of the activity, Spin On This. Completing the wider mission chain also provides access to additional rewards, including a unique gold SMG. There are 20 total Kitty Litter Labs. You only need to destroy 15 of them to progress with the Spin On This side mission.

sources.title: All 11 GTA 6 meditation spots and where to find them
sources.text: Finding meditation spots in GTA 6 will give you a permanent Focus boost There are 11 meditation spots in GTA 6 you can find and use to gain a boost to your max Focus. Confusingly, however, there's a trophy or achievement for meditating a total of 18 times in the game. That's because there are two tutorial spots that only Jason can access, and which one you get depends on what you do before the end of Chapter 1 in GTA 6 . After that there are eight spots that both Jason and Lucia can both do separately, and then a final spot that unlocks at the end that they can only do together. Not the clearest system in terms of making 11 add up to 18 but if you just follow the map below you'll find them all. They're often highlighted or pinpointed as you play and explore, but if you want that sweet Focus boost sooner rather than later it's worth chasing, as well as looking into the other GTA 6 max stat increasing missions you can find. Generally, meditation spots will be marked out with rocks and candles , with the spot itself a small circular mat placed on a rug. They should pop up when you get close enough, if they haven't been noted on the map already via texts and conversations. Just remember that of the 11 up there, you'll only get one of the first two for Jason, then the next eight need to be used by both Jason and Lucia separately, to activate the final one that can then only be done together. For that reason alone you're best always visiting these spots as a couple and getting it ticked off for both of them to save you coming back later. © GamesRadar+. sources.name: GamesIndustry.biz
sources.title: Staff at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar vote against union recognition deal
sources.text: Workers at Grand Theft Auto maker Rockstar Games have voted against a union recognition deal. 1,544 staff members took part in the vote across the company's locations in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee and London, representing a 93.2% turnout. Despite this huge engagement, 75.3% voted against Independent Workers of Great Britain (IWGB) union recognition, while 24.7% voted in favour. Had this vote gone the other way, IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would have been the biggest recognised union in the UK games industry, and Rockstar would have been obligated to engage with collective bargaining on pay and working hours. "We are extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6," the company's head of publishing, Jennifer Kolbe, said in a statement. "This result reflects our team's strong support for continuing the direct relationships, collaboration and open dialogue that have helped make Rockstar Games so innovative and strong. As we look ahead, we're excited to build on all we've accomplished together," said a company rep. IWGB says that Rockstar staff will keep organising regardless of whether the union is formally recognised. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society – this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for," the organisation said in its own statement. "Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favour of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognise we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues. We’re ready to put in the effort to make that happen. "Whilst we haven’t emerged with a recognition deal, this ballot has put our union on the radar of every worker, and opened the door for new kinds of conversation to start happening. People entirely unfamiliar with unions were for the first time debating employment conditions, collective bargaining rights, and our contracts. We heard from many more colleagues about what mattered to them, and we hope people will continue to engage so that we can see where these new discussions can lead us. "A recognition agreement would have marked a path towards greater workplace democracy. But it’s one route of many. At Rockstar we have already won, and will continue to win, tangible changes that improve our everyday lives. We’ll keep fighting for a say. For pay transparency, contractual overtime pay, and protections against AI and layoffs. "The power to shape our working lives has always been, and will always be, in our hands." Under UK law, the union may not re-apply for recognition for three years, although staff remain free to join the RGWU. The question of forming a union at Rockstar Games followed allegations that 34 members of staff were let go from the Grand Theft Auto maker in a move that IWGB called union-busting . Rockstar parent company Take-Two has denied this claim, saying that staff were fired for "distributing and discussing confidential information". Rockstar and IWGB are currently embroiled in an employment tribunal regarding these job cuts; closing arguments were issued on November 19 . Judge Lucy Wiseman, who oversaw proceedings, said that there is no timeframe yet for the judgement, but said she would try her best to "get that judgement out as quickly as possible". Grand Theft Auto 6 launched on November 19th and made a record $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours on sale .

stories.title: The Fable reboot had to look beyond Lionhead's RPG trilogy because games like The Witcher 3 "became the gold standard"
stories.summary: Developer Playground Games had to look beyond Lionhead's original run of Fable games when rebooting the classic fantasy series, and it's all thanks to games like The Witcher 3 , which changed what many players expect from their big RPGs and set a new "gold standard." Read more

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: The Fable reboot had to look beyond Lionhead's RPG trilogy because games like The Witcher 3 "became the gold standard"
sources.text: Developer Playground Games had to look beyond Lionhead's original run of Fable games when rebooting the classic fantasy series, and it's all thanks to games like The Witcher 3 , which changed what many players expect from their big RPGs and set a new "gold standard." The upcoming Fable reboot is finally ending its decade-long development journey soon. Playground Games had to set up an entirely new team to work on its fairytale revival, so Fable's production wasn't quite as smooth sailing as the studio's consistently excellent Forza Horizon series, for example. Asked about what's changed during that time, in an interview with GamesIndustry.biz , studio founder and general manager Ralph Fulton named technological advancements as a biggie, but the impact of other games was perhaps even greater. "In 2015, The Witcher 3 redefined what an open-world action RPG looks like and became the gold standard," Fulton said. "And after that bar was raised, the Assassin's Creed franchise changed into this more modern iteration with Origins, Odyssey, and Valhalla, and became like a quasi-RPG." "All of these games continue to reset player expectations," he continued. Millions of players suddenly had certain expectations about what their big-budget, open-world role-playing games should look like. So, Playground couldn't pull inspiration from Fable and Fable alone. "I think looking only to the original Fable trilogy for inspiration would leave us lacking in terms of what the modern audience, the modern marketplace, expects," Fulton added. Still, Playground's Fable is drawing most heavily from Lionhead's Fable. Fulton specifically mentions the game's signature British wit and in-flux morality system as examples. Then there's also the spontaneous life sim elements that "none of our competitors do," according to Fulton. "It's a totally Fable thing, the social simulation and economic simulation. Okay, there are games that have economic simulations, but they're not in [our] RPG category. Fable is unique in that it's almost like a life sim in terms of genre." Raising four separate families and becoming the entire map's benevolent landlord was one of the funnest parts of Fable back in the day, alongside those sometimes silly characters. Seeing next year's Fable lean into those systemic choices, and having Albion's NPCs react to them more believably, could give this one a very long shelf life.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: All Missing Persons locations in GTA 6
sources.text: Catch Port Gellhorn's creepy serial killer and end the 20-year mystery. The GTA 6 Missing Persons case is available as early as Chapter 1, but you'll need access to both Lucia and Jason to wrap up the side quest in Chapter 2. Your stint as a fledgling detective begins in an abandoned warehouse near Mo's shop in Gellhorn, though there are two ways to flag the objective on your map and start the hunt for Gellhorn's serial killer. If you begin in Chapter 1 when you can only play as Jason, head straight to the abandoned warehouse to begin. This is how I began the quest the first time, after following a pack of coyotes through a small opening on the side of the abandoned warehouse. This route gives you an extra text conversation where Jason sends Lucia creepy photos from the warehouse. Begin in Chapter 2 by heading to the Starlet Motel lobby in Gellhorn and inspecting the missing persons posters. Afterward, head to the abandoned warehouse as a couple or go alone, and squeeze through the crawl space. After crawling inside the warehouse, walk to the far end and turn right to enter the glowing red room. Go a little farther to find the, uh, "trophies," and inspect all three lockers, along with the missing persons posters on the wall. This is where you begin your hunt for Gellhorn's three missing tourists. I've got all three locations highlighted below, but if you want to solve it yourself, now is the time to turn back. The first missing person in northwest Gellhorn is in an abandoned trailer—the water tower's shadow is your giveaway. Run along the fence and enter the blue building from the back. There's an awfully suspicious hole in the floor, so pull the remaining floorboards back to discover what's left of Patrick Murray. Call the Kelly County Tip Line after you find Patrick's remains and leave a message. No one will answer the phone, for now. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. The second missing person is in the junkyard, inside the trunk of an old pink DeVanity. The junkyard is right beside Pay 'n' Spray off Gellhorn Ave, across the street from the drive-in theatre. You'll spot Susanne Keeble's pink car with the PRTYGRL license plate while facing the drive-in. After finding a second body, call the tip line again to finally speak to an investigator. They're thrilled to hear there's renewed interest in the case, and ask that you keep in contact should you make any further discoveries. The third missing person is in a U-shaped inlet off the Borrachero Sound. You can find the smaller body of water by traveling southeast from the Wild Hog Point hangar. The view of Wild Hog Point from the tree in the creepy photo is your giveaway, so start looking for a submerged car when you find the right perspective. After finding a third body, the investigator from the tip line asks to meet in the abandoned warehouse. And no, it's not just you, it's a pretty shady proposition. When you're ready for the meeting, consider whether you want to go with your partner or go alone. Both seem to give me the same boost to Jason and Lucia's relationship status, elevating it to Hot Together (4/4) status for the first time in Chapter 2. It had dropped all the way down to Partners in Crime (2/4) just before this, so the Missing Persons quest was a much-appreciated bump. You can also get the serial killer's glasses from his body if you choose to continue as a couple. They're beyond creepy, so I wouldn't blame you if you left them there, but aside from that, there's no cash reward. You will have to do it, though, if you're going for a 100% GTA 6 run. As either Jason or Lucia, return to the abandoned warehouse trophy room and meet Alvan West—the man you spoke to on the Kelly County Tips Line. He's got a 'surprise' waiting for you in the fourth locker, and a fight ensues after checking it out. Going alone means there's no one there to save the passed out Jason or Lucia, and the serial killer takes them to a cave in Lummox County. The attack automatically triggers a character swap, leaving you to investigate your partner's whereabouts after receiving suspicious texts. Enter the abandoned warehouse trophy room just like before while your partner waits outside. When they sense something is off, they'll run inside to save you just as you pass out. After Alvan is dead, inspect his body—you can take his glasses as a souvenir. That's freak behavior, but I'm not judging. We gotta get that 100% cosmetic collection somehow. sources.title: GTA 6 President’s Bunker questline walkthrough: All Locations, Codes, Puzzles and Rewards
sources.text: How to complete the President’s Bunker mission in GTA 6 Wondering how to open the President’s Bunker in GTA 6? The President’s Bunker hidden mission in GTA 6 is one of the most complex, but with this guide, you’ll be able to complete it and get the secret tank as a reward. This GTA 6 President’s Bunker walkthrough explains how to start the mission, find both bunkers, discover every code and collect the exclusive rewards, including a unique pistol, an assault rifle and a military tank. For even more GTA 6 guides, check out our GTA 6 walkthrough hub. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. The GTA 6 President’s Bunker mission starts in Downtown Vice City by speaking to a random man near a statue that comemorates the war. Start by travelling to Downtown, specifically the Friends of Freedom memorial on Catalan Boulevard. Check the image above for the speficic location. The memorial is dedicated to President Joe Russo and is located in the eastern part of Downtown.Look for an elderly man sitting near the memorial wall. This is Jose Bermudez, the character who introduces players to the hidden bunker storyline. Approach him and start a conversation. When the dialogue options appear, select: Jose will begin explaining his version of the Presidential assassination and reveal that he has evidence connected to the incident. This is the start of a questline that leads you to the President’s Bunker.Â He will also direct you towards his apartment in Little Cuba. He notes that you can find this apartment by looking for a large number of Cuban flags outside the door. Your next destination is Little Cuba, specifically NW 4th Avenue. Look for a salmon-coloured building decorated with Cuban flags, located near a vehicle modification shop. You can see an image of the apartment building below.Â Enter the building and head upstairs to find Jose’s apartment. Inside the apartment, there are several important clues that you should investigate: Make sure you listen to the complete recording rather than leaving halfway through. The information provided here becomes important when accessing the first bunker if you’re completing the quest organically. I suppose if you’re reading this then you don’t need to do this at all. Come to think of it, I don’t even know if you need to do this part of the quest before you head to Sharktooth Island. Once you’ve finished investigating Jose’s apartment, it’s time to travel to the first bunker. The facility is located on Sharktooth Island, a small island north of Waning Sands. Because the location is surrounded by water, taking a boat is recommended. You can also swim across, although travelling by boat is considerably more convenient. If you get stuck out there, there’s a boat that spawns on the opposite shore of the island from the bunker itself. On the north shore of Sharktooth Island, you’ll find the entrance to the bunker. Interact with the keypad and enter the following code: After entering the bunker, you’ll discover that the facility has no electricity. Follow the underground passage and look for the power switch. Turn right inside the tunnel to locate the electrical control panel. Interact with it to restore power. Once the electricity is working, return through the passage and take the opposite route into the main bunker. You’ll now be able to investigate the presidential facility. Inside the bunker, look around for documents, recordings and other evidence. On one desk there’s a picture of President Russo meeting with an alien on Mount Chilliad. Mount Chilliad was the site of much speculation in te GTA 5 era due to clues about an apart alien mystery, and the fact that a UFO would appear over the mountain when players 100%’d the game. Continue looking around the room until you reach the presidential desk. Interact with the desk and investigate its contents. This will help activate the next part of the puzzle. Jason or Lucia will sit back and begin to make jokes about them being President. It doesn’t matter which of the two you play as. The presidential safe contains one of the most valuable rewards in the entire bunker mission: Russo’s 1922 Pistol. However, opening it requires solving a small puzzle. Here it is in beat-by-beat steps. Enter the combination into the safe to unlock it. Inside, you’ll find Russo’s 1922 Pistol and a mysterious photograph which leads to the second part of the quest. Make sure you collect the pistol and inspect the photograph before leaving. On the back of the picture you’ll find the word: OBSESS. This is the code to enter the second bunker. It is an underground IAA black site located in the forests of North Mariana County, close to the Big Pine area. Travel towards the forested area near Big Pine. Look for a hidden underground hatch rather than the large bunker door. You can see it pictured below.Â The keypad to enter the bunker is attached to a nearby tree, making it relatively easy to miss if you’re simply searching for a conventional entrance. sources.title: Lenny Kravitz Brings Bawma, the Pirate King of Aleph in 007 First Light, to HITMAN World of Assassination
sources.text: Agent 47 has a new client, and he isn’t usually the type to stay in the shadows. HITMAN World of Assassination’s latest Elusive Target, The Mutiny, stars Lenny Kravitz as Bawma, the magnetic and unpredictable Pirate King of Aleph, first brought to life in 007 First Light . Kravitz lends both his likeness and his voice to the character, who crosses over into the World of Assassination for the first time. The Mutiny Elusive Target mission is available globally on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, ROG Xbox Ally X, ROG Xbox Ally, and PC starting Thursday, November 26, through Thursday, December 24, 2026. From the opening briefing, it’s clear this assignment is unusual. Diana never lets a client brief 47 directly, but Bawma has paid the Agency generously and insists on directing the operation himself. Little is known about the man behind the alias: intelligence suggests he was raised as a child soldier before building Aleph, a sprawling black-market hub in the Western Hemisphere that he calls his kingdom. Now he’s hiding out on Ambrose Island, and 47’s objective is simple: find Bawma, make contact, and await further instructions. Once 47 tracks Bawma down through the island’s ruins and jungles, it soon becomes clear that something far more valuable is at stake. Three of Bawma’s rogue lieutenants stand in the way, and none of them will part with what they’re holding easily. Bawma stays in 47’s ear throughout the mission, and with its bright, upbeat tone and easygoing holiday feel, The Mutiny is one of the most laid-back contracts in the World of Assassination. On Ambrose Island, though, nothing is ever straightforward, and fortune favors the bold. Bold players will want to pay a visit to Madame Serafine. All three targets can be eliminated with a Voodoo Doll: gather the ingredients, add them to the Ritual Bowl, and pick up the doll Madame Serafine creates. Then “kill” the doll to take out its target, whether that means stabbing it with a knife, throwing it in water, shooting it or blowing it up, hitting it with a thrown sharp object, or exposing it to fire or electricity. As with all Elusive Targets, The Mutiny will be removed from the game when it expires on December 24. However, players who own HITMAN World of Assassination or the Ambrose Island location will keep access to The Retaliator, the Arcade version of the mission, as well as its Special Assignment, completely for free. Players who complete The Mutiny with an IOI Account while it’s live will also unlock the Rock Royalty Duck, a regal rubber duck in flashy sunglasses that detonates when it detects nearby motion. Launching alongside The Mutiny, IO Interactive is also releasing the Rockstar Pack, a collection of outfits, weapons, gear, and Freelancer Safehouse cosmetics inspired by the bold style and electric energy of rock ’n’ roll icons. The pack is available for $5.99/€5.99/£4.99 and includes:

sources.title: Origament: A Paper Adventure now available for PS5, Switch
sources.text: Platformer adventure game Origament: A Paper Adventure is now available for PlayStation 5 and Switch for $9.99 / €9.99, publisher Assemble Entertainment and developer Space Sauce announced. Origament: A Paper Adventure first launched for PC via Steam on April 7. Here is an overview of the game, via Assemble Entertainment: Deep inside the Archive of Memory, forgotten letters sleep in endless drawers. But one little letter has other plans. Awakened by a mysterious spark, it escapes through a Time Glitch and sets off on an adventure across time and continents. Somewhere out there, someone is still waiting to read it. And that letter? That’s you! From moonlit gardens to the Wild West, every world has a story to tell and a clue to uncover. Are you ready to deliver the most important letter of all?
